Expo provides a React Native framework, libraries and tools for development, builds and
distribution. Expo Go has a fixed native runtime; a development build can include your own native
dependencies.
Expo මගින් React Native app එක develop සහ build කරන්න පහසු Jවනවා. අලුතේ native library
එකකේ අවශ්‍ය නම් development build එකකේ ඕන Jවන්න පුළුවන්.

npx create-expo-app@latest movie-app
cd movie-app
npx expo start
Expected result: A development server starts; open on a supported device.

What is Expo Go vs a development build? Go is a prebuilt sandbox; a dev build includes your app's
native code.
